record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: Cranidos (1 star), Rampardos (2 stars) and Type: Null (2 stars, passive TYPE_NULL) declare ABILITY HEAD_SMASH (maxPP 100, range 1). The Type: Null passive is a separate record and is not described here.
record.summary: Single-target burst with flat recoil and a sleep/freeze execution. If the cast target is asleep or frozen, the caster deals 9999 TRUE damage to it (requested; the table damage is not used). Otherwise it deals star-indexed flat SPECIAL damage (40/80/150/300, requested). Afterwards, unless the caster holds Protective Pads, it takes flat PHYSICAL recoil (10/20/40/80, requested) through its own handleSpecialDamage. Both damage instances take the caster's AP percentage and, if the cast crit, the crit multiplier. No movement and no status is applied. requiresTarget is the default true.

targeting.who: the cast target (damage); the caster itself (recoil)
targeting.note: Single target, no area. The sleep/freeze test reads the status of the cast target at the moment of the cast.

geometry.detail: No adjacency, line or movement logic.

effects.target: the cast target (not asleep and not frozen)
effects.scaling: Requested amount = table value, AttackType.SPECIAL. handleSpecialDamage(requested, board, SPECIAL, caster, crit) with the default apBoost = true: + requested x caster AP/100, x2 if the caster has DOUBLE_DAMAGE (effect consumed), x1.2 with the strange-steam board effect, then the crit multiplier only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT; canCritByDefault is false), reduced by the target's Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite.
effects.resolution: Requested amount is pre-defence. A target with protect, skydiving or magicBounce takes none (magicBounce reflects if the caster lacks Protective Pads). Otherwise handleDamage applies the target's Special Defense, other damage reductions, shields and the minimum of 1 (core-mechanics.md section A); the applied/taken amount is what handleDamage reports as takenDamage.

effects.target: the cast target when it is asleep or frozen (status.sleep or status.freeze truthy)
effects.scaling: Requested amount 9999 as AttackType.TRUE, replacing the table damage (it is the only damage instance on the target in this branch). It still goes through handleSpecialDamage with the default apBoost, so AP percentage, DOUBLE_DAMAGE, strange steam and crit multiply 9999 before handleDamage. The true-damage branch skips Defense and Special Defense and the percentage reductions that are applied to non-TRUE damage.
effects.resolution: Blocked entirely by protect, skydiving or magicBounce on the target. Otherwise the requested figure is far above any normal HP pool; whether shields absorb it first was not traced beyond core-mechanics.md section A, and the minimum of 1 does not matter at this size.

effects.target: the caster itself (unless it holds Protective Pads)
effects.scaling: Requested recoil = table value, AttackType.PHYSICAL, dealt by pokemon.handleSpecialDamage(recoil, board, PHYSICAL, caster, crit) with the default apBoost, so the recoil also takes the caster's AP percentage, the DOUBLE_DAMAGE doubling if the effect was not consumed by the damage to the target (it is consumed by the target damage unless that was blocked), strange steam x1.2 and the crit multiplier if the cast crit. It is dealt after the target damage in both branches.
effects.resolution: Skipped when the caster has Protective Pads. Blocked if the caster itself has protect, skydiving or magicBounce (magicBounce does not reflect a PHYSICAL hit). Otherwise handleDamage applies the caster's Defense, shields and the minimum of 1; it can lower the caster to 0 HP (death handling not traced beyond handleDamage).

starBehavior.note: Caster stars index both tables (1-4, fallback 300 and 80). The listed units are 1 star (Cranidos) and 2 stars (Rampardos, Type: Null), so the 150/300 and 40/80 entries are not used by any listed unit.

record.positionalConditions: None beyond having a target. Only the target's sleep or freeze status changes the branch.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state. Each cast re-reads the target's sleep and freeze status.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: SPECIAL 40/80/80 (Cranidos/Rampardos/Type: Null) and PHYSICAL recoil 10/20/20, or 9999 TRUE on a sleeping or frozen target (then no table damage; recoil unchanged). Applied: AP percentage, DOUBLE_DAMAGE, strange steam and crit scale each instance before handleDamage, the recoil included; Protective Pads removes the recoil. Taken: defences (none for the TRUE branch), shields and the minimum of 1 decide takenDamage on the target and on the caster separately.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: state.handleDamage body (defences, shield absorption, minimum of 1) only through the shared reference core-mechanics.md section A and the cited lines
Whether sleep or freeze is removed or altered by damage before or after the sleep/freeze test is not part of this ability (the test runs first, once)
unresolved: Shield absorption of the 9999 TRUE damage was not traced
The Type: Null passive (and its evolution into Silvally) is a separate record and may change stats used here, not the ability logic
Death handling of a caster that dies to its own recoil was not traced
No gameplay evidence: no probe or match was run; this is source reading plus mechanical checks

crit rolled only with ABILITY_CRIT or canCritByDefault
target asleep or frozen: 9999 TRUE damage instead of the table damage
PHYSICAL recoil on the caster via handleSpecialDamage unless Protective Pads
AP boost, DOUBLE_DAMAGE, strange steam, crit
